title: Campus clean-up held at K. Karasaev Bishkek State University

blocks.text: In accordance with instruction No. 20-11305 of the Administration of the President of the Kyrgyz Republic dated 15 September 2026, a university-wide volunteer clean-up was held on 19 September at Bishkek State University named after Academician K. Karasaev.
Participants cleaned and improved the university grounds and their sanitary condition. Students and employees of the university actively took part in the event.
